choice: Scoped ZIP-imported tools to the current group to prevent cross-group data modification and theft.
final:
Fixed ZIP imports to resolve tools within the importer’s group, preventing crafted tool IDs from renaming or taking another group’s tools.

The regression test reproduced the flaw before the fix. Afterward, `python3 -m pytest tests/integration_tests/user_recipe_tests/test_recipe_crud.py -q` passed all 68 tests.
